Hohner.notes: Use Productfinder (hohner.de/en/products) for model-specific URLs. hohner.com is industrial sensors (wrong company). Correct spelling is Hohner — do not search for Hoehner.

Humes & Berg.notes: Brass instrument mutes; limited online catalog — relies on retail partners for product sales

Tagima.notes: US site has English catalog; BR site may have additional regional models

Yamaha.notes: US subdomain required; global site redirects to regional versions

Zildjian.notes: Direct /products/[sku] URL 404s — use /search?q=[sku]&type=product. CDN at zildjian.com/cdn/shop/ — strip &width= params, keep ?v= cache-buster.
